Title: Fix: Prevent mount conflicts and improve script stability with isolated scratch directories
Decision: Separate driver-enabled boot mount; guarded PowerShell cleanup with bounded retries; preserve source files after failed/unknown dismount. No cmd deletion fallback or new global cleanup.

Title: Restore image edition metadata lost during export (fixes #583)
Decision: Restore missing Setup fields from actual source using wimlib info --image-property and --check; reject conflicts; retain integrity and compression. No raw header rewrite.

Title: Disable AI Features and Improvements
